purpose: South-facing exploration idle STATIC frame for the male protagonist at the approved 48 logical px, authored fresh as clean hand-placed clusters paired to the approved female selout v8 rendering density; editable Pixelorama role layers.
status: UNAPPROVED, NONRUNTIME pilot; technical gates only; not runtime-integrated; no animation; south only
authorship: Colour and role grids placed part by part by Claude (Claude Code, signed-in Claude Max, claude.ai firstParty, no API key) as hand-chosen spans, polygons, strokes and small stamps, then frozen as the literal grids in the tool. No image generation, no sampling of the concept sheet, no resampling, filtering, quantization or dithering; no v8 texel or palette entry copied.
not_used_as_base: local unapproved male high-density v01/v02 pilots

benchmark.female_selout_v8: density/proportion/light benchmark only (same 80x112 cell, pin, 96-texel body, 0.5 scale, 1-texel near-black outline, upper-left light, 3-4 step material ramps); v8 files are hash-locked and never written.

identity_anchors_from_sheet.hair: tousled dark-brown short hair with uneven outward tufts, wider than the face, fringe over the forehead (not a rounded cap, not a ponytail)
identity_anchors_from_sheet.face: young adult male, thick straight brows, dark eyes, small closed smile, face turned slightly to the viewer-left
identity_anchors_from_sheet.scarf: tea-green scarf wrapped at the neck with a short front point
identity_anchors_from_sheet.coat: open warm grey-brown field coat to the knee with popped collar, leather piping and rolled sleeves showing cream cuffs and forearms
identity_anchors_from_sheet.pack_bedroll: teal bedroll with a spiral end on top of a brown leather pack behind the viewer-right shoulder; harness straps on the chest
identity_anchors_from_sheet.other: cream laced shirt, teal community-diamond emblem, belt with steel buckle, teal sash at the viewer-left hip, fingerless gloves, olive-grey trousers with a knee pad and cargo pocket, tall cuffed brown boots
identity_anchors_from_sheet.pose: relaxed idle: viewer-left hand gripping the pack strap at the chest (as in the sheet), viewer-right arm hanging, weight on the viewer-right leg, relaxed leg angled out with the foot set back

png.role: transparent runtime-CANDIDATE PNG (not wired into the game)

pxo.format: Pixelorama pxo_version 7 (v1.2.3-stable), color_mode 5, 1 frame x 14 layers, fixed zip timestamps

ora.format: OpenRaster 0.0.3, same layers as the .pxo (guides hidden), mergedimage = the PNG
